acceptance_criterion: Rejection requires a reason of at least one non-whitespace character; without it the rejection is not performed, the status is unchanged, and no rejection timestamp is recorded
test_name: refuses a rejection with no reason, changing nothing

acceptance_criterion: A reason of whitespace only is refused
test_name: refuses a reason of whitespace only

acceptance_criterion: On rejection the status changes to Rejected and the reason, rejecting coordinator, and timestamp are recorded
test_name: rejects an event with a reason, recording the coordinator and the time

acceptance_criterion: The reason is visible to the owning organiser
test_name: shows the reason to the owning organiser

acceptance_criterion: The organiser receives a notification of the rejection
test_name: notifies the organiser of the rejection, including the reason

acceptance_criterion: A rejected event cannot be edited or resubmitted; its fields become read-only
test_name: makes a rejected event read-only: it cannot be resubmitted

acceptance_criterion: An event that already carries a decision cannot be rejected
test_name: cannot reject an event that already carries a decision

acceptance_criterion: The rejection writes a status history entry like any other transition (F1)
test_name: writes a history entry for the rejection (F1)

acceptance_criterion: Only an Event Coordinator may reject (A2)
test_name: refuses a role that is not an Event Coordinator (A2)

acceptance_criterion: The rejection reason is recorded with the decision
test_name: records a rejection with its reason

acceptance_criterion: Without a reason the rejection is not performed, and the refusal is shown where the reason is entered
test_name: shows the refusal inside the rejection dialog

acceptance_criterion: Rejection is offered through a confirming dialog where the reason is entered, and that dialog opens in the app as mounted
test_name: shows the rejection dialog attached to the page
